style: Natural photorealistic editorial workplace photography, neutral daylight; no personal data or futuristic graphics. Website adds illustrative disclaimers.

scenes.prompt: An HR programme lead and wellbeing consultant discussing a voluntary employee wellbeing programme at a bright Nordic office meeting table, printed programme calendar, no personal health records.
Two adult office colleagues taking a relaxed outdoor walking break beside a modern office, one glancing at a smartphone, candid everyday wellbeing, no athletic competition.
A diverse group of adult colleagues on an inclusive team walking challenge in an office courtyard, cheerful natural collaboration, no winners podium or body comparisons.
HR and business analysts reviewing a simple aggregate participation trend chart on a monitor in a meeting room, no employee names or individual health scores, no legible text.
Two software product engineers mapping smartwatch and smartphone data inputs on paper at an office desk, devices beside laptop, no holograms.
Software developers testing a service integration at two monitors showing generic structured JSON records and a simple data mapping diagram, no legible keys or credentials.
A product designer and engineer reviewing a generic wellness application on a phone and response charts on a laptop, realistic office, no diagnostic claims.
A technology partnership manager and engineer reviewing a generic monthly API request volume chart and commercial worksheet at a meeting table, no currency figures or readable text.
